recap.text: Hunter Zabit, a four-armed Atoll Beastmaster with no mouth and a dozen nostril holes, sends a Night Weasel Scout named Tootsie to disable Crawler Carl. Carl, Mongo, and Princess Donut kill the weasels, and Zabit spends twenty-five scalps at Chaco's counter on a drop shield and an invisibility pack. Zabit hunts to pay for the oxygen and land of the Atoll. Carl casts Tripper, and Zabit is torn in half by his own landmine traps.

beats.headline: Tootsie, and the rest of them
beats.text: Night Weasel Scout, level twenty-five, name Tootsie, dragging itself on one leg across the ground toward Crawler Carl's paralysed face. This a pet of Hunter Zabit. A gang runs to about twenty, invisible, with scouts that smell prey across hundreds of kilometres and disable it for the rest. A lava-rock crawler stamps Tootsie flat, Mongo eats the second one, and Crawler Princess Donut raises a dead weasel against its own pack. Carl is carried into a pub like luggage, and a guard's poison cloud clears the street outside.
beats.gist: A level twenty-five Night Weasel Scout named Tootsie drags itself toward Carl's paralysed face.

beats.headline: Twenty-five scalps at the counter
beats.text: Chaco's prize counter. Hunter Zabit: level sixty-six Beastmaster, an Atoll, tall and thin with four arms, three fingers to a hand, no mouth, a dozen nostril holes, and a trap module bandolier on his belt. He speaks by signing into something hidden in his clothes. Yes, the weasels were his. He meant to catch the top prey early, and the party killed his pets and his season with them. He collected twenty-five scalps anyway, and spends them: a drop shield for twenty, an invisibility pack for three.
beats.gist: Hunter Zabit is a four-armed Atoll Beastmaster who spends twenty-five scalps on a shield and invisibility pack.

beats.headline: For the survival of the Atoll
beats.text: Crawler Carl asks why he hunts people who are scared and weaker than he is. Hunter Zabit's answer, for the record: for the survival of the Atoll. They are not citizens, so oxygen and land are not rights. The scalp money pays the upkeep on their habitat, and without it they would have to accept indenture under another system. This season's failure hurts his people. Some hunters revel in the killing; for others it is survival. He would object too, were the situations reversed.
beats.gist: Carl asks Hunter Zabit why he hunts the weak; Zabit answers it ensures the Atoll's survival.

beats.headline: Closing the semicircle
beats.text: Lucia Mar sits at the prize counter, chatting and waving her tequila bottle as if every crawler present were her best friend, with a ring of crawlers around her to keep the hunters off. The hunters form a second semicircle around that one: Vrah, Hunter Zabit, and several draconians, moving in. Chaco backs himself against the wall. Crawler Carl reads the play at once. They are trying to get Lucia to break the peace seal.
beats.gist: Lucia Mar waves a tequila bottle while Hunter Zabit and other hunters surround the crawlers.

beats.headline: His own landmines
beats.text: Final arena. Hunter Zabit's dot is on the map, and when Crawler Carl moves in, the hunter points at him, shouts something that does not carry, and vanishes. Carl stops. He has seen that belt, and he knows what was in it. He casts Tripper. Several landmine traps go off at once, and Zabit reappears, torn in half by his own trap, laid seconds before. The announcement follows directly: team two, eliminated.
beats.gist: Hunter Zabit vanishes and reappears torn in half by his own landmine traps after Carl casts Tripper.

relations.note: Spent his scalps at the prize counter
